response.justification: Bogdan is a highly skilled full-stack engineer with 16+ years of experience, but is fundamentally unsuitable for this embedded security role. Most critically, the position requires native-level Japanese proficiency, which is entirely absent from his profile (lists only English, Romanian, and basic German). Beyond this disqualifying gap, his entire career has focused on web development, full-stack software, and high-level applications with minimal experience in embedded firmware, security technologies, or networking infrastructure—the core domains of this role. His limited C programming background and lack of Linux kernel or security expertise further highlight the domain mismatch.
strengths: Extensive 16+ year track record as senior/staff engineer demonstrating strong system design, technical leadership, and delivery across diverse platforms with proven ability to master complex codebases
Deep expertise in infrastructure and DevOps including CI/CD, microservices architecture handling millions of requests/second, containerization, and distributed system design
Polyglot programmer proficient across multiple languages (TypeScript, D Lang, Java, C++, Swift) with strong software fundamentals and demonstrated capacity to quickly learn new technologies
concerns: Critical disqualifier: No Japanese language proficiency despite position requiring native-level fluency; resume lists only English (fluent), Romanian (fluent), and German (basic)
Completely absent security domain expertise in encryption, authentication systems, key exchange protocols, tamper detection, or embedded security—the primary focus of this role
Career focused on web and full-stack development with minimal embedded firmware, hardware control, Linux kernel work, or networking infrastructure experience required for LAN-switch products
